newsitem.title: USA: August US replacement lead battery shipments rise.
newsitem.headline: August US replacement lead battery shipments rise.

text.p: Shipments of replacement lead batteries in the United States rose 7.56 percent in August from July to 6,702,982 units, the Battery Council International reported.
Shipments in August were 4.4 percent down from the 7,014,414 units shipped in the same month last year.
In January through August shipments rose 4.23 percent to 48,407,805 units.
According to BCI's 12-month moving total, shipments in the year ending August 1996 were 2.4 percent above those in the prior twelve months.
